title: The Origami Phoenix
summary: An interactive Three.js origami sculpture where a calligraphed crimson sheet folds itself into a gilded phoenix taking flight over a shrine.
description: Burning Fold Rebirth is a 30-second interactive Three.js sculpture and short film. A calligraphed crimson paper sheet lifts along diagonal creases, fans out gilded tail feathers, takes flight over a lantern-lit shrine, and settles gently back onto its basalt altar.
